The issuer shows tight liquidity (current ratio of 1.04) and very high leverage (total liabilities of 111,269M versus shareholders’ equity of 18,677M). While profitability appears decent (EBIT of 2,359M on revenue of 12,717M, implying a relatively healthy operating margin), the combination of thin liquidity and substantial balance-sheet leverage constrains credit quality to the lower end of the speculative grade.

DECISION: BB-
